subject: Privileged access telemetry & ownership — evidence ask
messages:
From: Aaron Feldman <aaron.feldman@medhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Privileged access telemetry & ownership — evidence ask

Hi Priya,

Thanks for taking this — MedHealth is in the middle of a SIG/SOC2 intake and we need a focused set of artifacts around access ownership and privileged accounts. Attached is our intake questionnaire (SIG_questionnaire_MedHealth_v2.pdf). Specific asks we need to validate: 

- A CSV or graph export showing current role assignments for high-privilege roles (admins, infra, billing, support) plus service-account ownership.
- SCIM delta or sample provisioning events covering last 90 days (create/modify/deactivate).
- Example SAML assertion with at least one production assertion sample for an admin login.
- An explanation of least-privilege controls: role naming conventions, role-to-resource mapping, and how transient admin access is granted/rotated.
- Any redaction guidance we should follow before upload.

Timeline: ideally we get the artifacts by EOD Thu (2026-10-01) so the auditor can start mapping. If you need an exceptions cadence, please flag which items require privileged access to pull.

Attachments: SIG_questionnaire_MedHealth_v2.pdf (questionnaire)

Regards,
Aaron Feldman
Security Engineering — MedHealth Systems
aaron.feldman@medhealth.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Feldman <aaron.feldman@medhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Privileged access telemetry & ownership — evidence ask

Aaron — thanks, we can cover this. Quick plan below (I own the delivery):

Plan / deliverables
- Access graph export (CSV) that maps users / groups -> roles for privileged roles; include owner column where available. (attachment: access-graph-sample.csv)
- SCIM delta snippet (ndjson) capturing sample create/update/deactivate events for 90-day window; will redact PII and provide a redaction_map_v1.xlsx describing transformations. (attachment: scim-delta-snippet.ndjson, redaction_map_v1.xlsx)
- One production SAML assertion sample (with PII redacted) and short doc describing common claim mappings.
- A short narrative (one page) covering our least-privilege model, temporary elevation workflow, and service-account rotation cadence.

Timeline
- Internal pull + redaction pass: Wed (2026-09-30)
- Final delivery to your secure intake bucket: Thu EOD (2026-10-01)

Notes / constraints
- The SCIM delta contains user emails and GUIDs; we will apply the redaction_map_v1.xlsx prior to export. If you need UID->employee mapping, that requires an NDA addendum and an approved ticket — let us know.
- For SAML assertions we will provide a single production sample; live assertion logs are not shareable without a signed access request.

If that timeline works, I'll confirm owners: Jordan will pull the SCIM and role mappings, Soojin will run the redaction and produce the redaction_map, and I'll assemble the narrative + package.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Privileged access telemetry & ownership — evidence ask

Priya / Jordan — small ops note:

On Wed, 29 Sep 2026 at 10:04 -0700, Priya Natarajan wrote:
> Aaron — thanks, we can cover this. Quick plan below (I own the delivery):
>
> Plan / deliverables
> - Access graph export (CSV) that maps users / groups -> roles for privileged roles; include owner column where available. (attachment: access-graph-sample.csv)
> - SCIM delta snippet (ndjson) capturing sample create/update/deactivate events for 90-day window; will redact PII and provide a redaction_map_v1.xlsx describing transformations.

Jordan — when you pull SCIM logs, please include the delta source id and event timestamp in UTC. I will apply the redaction_map and run a quick sanity check for any leftover email addresses in the attribute payloads. Also: identify any service accounts lacking an owner tag — we'll flag those as action items in the narrative.

I added a short checklist to our shared doc (link below) for the redaction steps.

Sooj
Sooj in Security Ops
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

From: Aaron Feldman <aaron.feldman@medhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Privileged access telemetry & ownership — evidence ask

Thanks Priya, Soojin, Jordan — that plan works. Two quick asks before you ship: 

1) Can you include a single row sample (non-production) for a service-account owner mapping? Auditor always wants to see an owner surface.
2) Can we schedule a 20-min handoff call Fri morning (your timezone) to walk the artifact package and redaction notes? I can bring our auditor (Lena).

If you send a couple of time slots I will confirm.

Regards,
Aaron
Security Engineering — MedHealth Systems
